objective: Describe whether fixed, no-lookahead multi-day market states consistently favor continuation or reversal for the unchanged fixed-five strategy cohort across 2023H1, 2023H2, 2024H1 and 2024H2.

authority_and_lineage.2023_transform_source: first_timestamp_mt4_server converted with the historical EA ServerToUtc rule
authority_and_lineage.fixed_trade_source: the unchanged five-strategy cohort from usdjpy_fixed5_exact_portability_result_v1

information_time: Every feature is calculated at the signal-bar close. Entry remains the next M15 bar. Exit, trade P/L and later bars are unavailable to feature construction.

fixed_windows.definition: 5 and 20 blocks of 96 completed M15 market bars, including the signal bar and using only prior close differences

market_direction_agreement.definition: sign of raw 5-day return followed by sign of raw 20-day return

trade_alignment_agreement.definition: sign of trade-side-aligned 5-day return followed by sign of trade-side-aligned 20-day return

path_efficiency_5d.definition: absolute 5-day net close move divided by sum of absolute M15 close moves

path_efficiency_20d.definition: absolute 20-day net close move divided by sum of absolute M15 close moves

realized_volatility_ratio_5d_to_20d.definition: RMS M15 close-return volatility over 480 bars divided by RMS volatility over 1920 bars

range_position_20d.definition: signal close position inside the trailing 1920-bar high-low range

fixed_action_accounting.continuation_default_net: existing gross pips minus existing default cost
fixed_action_accounting.reversal_default_net: negative existing gross pips minus the same default cost
fixed_action_accounting.continuation_severe_net: existing gross pips minus existing severe cost
fixed_action_accounting.reversal_severe_net: negative existing gross pips minus the same severe cost
fixed_action_accounting.disclosure: Reversal P/L is an algebraic development-outcome-derived counterfactual and is descriptive only. It is not a blind candidate test.

reporting: continuation and reversal net under default and severe costs
profit factor, win rate and date concentration

descriptive_robust_state_gate.purpose: A passing state may justify a later separate router preregistration. It does not activate a router in this stage.

prohibited: no tree search, clustering or parameter optimization
no interactions between feature families in v1
no strategy subset selection or portfolio weighting
no Family I or F05 local repair
no router candidate activation in this stage

decision_rule.one_or_more_states_pass: RETAIN_DESCRIPTIVE_STATE_SET_FOR_SEPARATE_ROUTER_REVIEW; do not select or preregister a router automatically
